notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 does not define a separate whole-class subscribeObjectClass service. The portable equivalent subscribes to every ordinary attribute in the adapter-selected class using subscribeObjectClassAttributes and verifies that exact handle set in the standard MIM report. Completeness is a fixture property supplied by the adapter FOM, not a new normative API claim. No DDM region behavior is covered.

requirements.statement: The subject federate subscribes through the standard attribute-set service to the complete adapter-configured attribute handle set for the selected object class; the requester verifies that the standard MIM object-class subscription report contains exactly those handles and the configured active state and update-rate designator.

The requester uses the standard MIM subscription request/report interactions to query the joined subject. The returned object-class subscription report identifies the selected class, active state, update-rate designator, and exact subscribed attribute-handle set, which is decoded through the public RTIambassador API.
